_comment: Phase 4 (F-04) single source of truth for network egress. Consumed by src/core/egress-policy.ts (runtime enforcement) AND scripts/check-bundle-hosts.mjs (post-build tripwire). Keep both readers in sync by editing ONLY this file.
_allowlist: Hosts the shipped code actually FETCHES. Exact, lowercase, no scheme, no port.
_hostPatterns: Regional hosts whose middle label is concatenated at runtime. A hostname matches when it starts with `prefix`, ends with `suffix`, and the single label in between matches [a-z0-9-]+ (so `sub.evil.example.vendor.com` does NOT match). Every suffix here must be a namespace the vendor itself controls: a suffix under which anyone can self-register a subdomain would hand a hostile build a ready-made allowlisted destination. EMPTY since hardening Phase 2.B removed the cloud provider surface that owned all four former entries; the mechanism stays because it is the only safe way to express a regional destination.
_loopbackHosts: http: is permitted only for these (Ollama / LM Studio / OAuth loopback listener).
_knownDocHosts: Hosts that appear as literals in the bundle but are NEVER fetched: documentation links, links opened in the user's browser, and placeholder examples. `ai-gateway.vercel.sh` is the `ai` SDK's built-in default gateway — it is deliberately listed HERE and NOT in `allowlist`, so the tripwire passes while the policy blocks any request to it. `cookbook.openai.com` and `developers.openai.com` are @see links inside the bundled @ai-sdk/openai JSDoc — they survived the Phase 2.B removal of the ChatGPT-subscription OAuth provider (which took the two hosts it fetched out of `allowlist`) because the SDK, not that provider, is what mentions them. `scripts/check-bundle-no-codex.mjs` names those two hosts; nothing else in the repo may.
_knownRuntimePrefixes: Truncated literals the bundle contains because a label is concatenated at runtime (`https://<prefix>.` + region + `.<suffix>`). The bundle scanner sees the prefix only, so it is accepted verbatim. Every entry must have a matching `hostPatterns` prefix. EMPTY since hardening Phase 2.B — the bundle no longer builds any host at runtime.
